inventory.description: SHA-256 over UTF-8 lines relative/path|byteLength|lowercaseFileSha256, ordinal-ignore-case sorted, with a final LF. Inputs are magick.exe, root DLL/XML files, License.txt, NOTICE.txt, and every file below modules. Identical algorithm to the x64 pin; only the bundle differs.

provenance.note: SAME upstream release as the x64 pin (7.1.2-29), so it carries the same 2026 policy.xml bypass fixes including CVE-2026-49219 and CVE-2025-66628. The ARM64 asset is an Inno installer rather than an installable-here package, so the payload was extracted with innoextract and placed at %ProgramFiles%\ImageMagick-7.1.2-Q16-HDRI-arm64 to match the x64 resolution rule. The extracted tree is the SAME 195-file set as x64, which is why the inventory algorithm is unchanged.
provenance.runtimeIdentityCheck: DEFERRED TO CI. check-magick-source.ps1 confirms the runtime version line by executing magick.exe, which an x64 host cannot do for an ARM64 binary. The 195-file SHA-256 inventory and the PE FileVersion still pin identity locally, and both are stronger than a printed version string; the executed check runs natively in the arm64 CI job.
